The carbon credits are be securitized into tokens using blockchain technology, making them highly liquid, fungible and tradable. The company also has a fund, the AirCarbon Registration Facility, which provides grants to finance the registration, consulting, issuance and audit fees of CO2-mitigating projects. AirCarbon also operates the AirCarbon Fund, an investment fund which invests in carbon-mitigating projects such as reforestation, methane capture and carbon emissions reduction. Through these projects, the fund also generates Corsia-compliant tradable carbon offsets, which are then listed on the exchange.
